fato_historico: 2008: A military junta led by Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz stages a coup d'état in Mauritania, overthrowing president Sidi Ould Cheikh Abdallahi.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite you to shift the internal landscape of your life. Just as tides turn and structures evolve within the world, you are encouraged to embrace your natural ability to reinvent yourself. It is a good time to release outdated patterns and embrace the hidden strength that resides deep within your Scorpio spirit today.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the grace of your own personal rebirth.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of energy and your internal resilience.
conselho: Trust your intuition and consider bold changes that reflect your true inner self.
